_comment: Claude models offered in the ChatGPT desktop picker. claude_model is passed to `claude --model`: an alias (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku) follows Claude Code to new releases, a full model id pins one version. For an alias, the version at the end of display_name is a starting point: once Claude Code starts a model for it, the picker shows that model's version. efforts lists the reasoning levels the model accepts; an empty list means the model has no effort setting.

models.description: Latest Claude Fable through Claude Code. Most capable, for ambitious long-running work.
Latest Claude Opus through Claude Code. Strong at long agentic work.
Latest Claude Sonnet through Claude Code. Fast and capable.
Latest Claude Haiku through Claude Code. Fastest, for simple tasks.
